user.title: Where does the bus position come from?
user.description: Pick the tracking provider. To use several (e.g. a Traccar server and a Bouncie account), add Bus Monitor once for each.

traccar.title: Connect to a Traccar GPS server
traccar.description: Paste the Traccar server address and login your bus company gave you. The address can be copied straight from your browser, with or without http://. If the server only works with http://, the login is not encrypted in transit.

data_description.base_url: For example gps.example.com:8082. Traccar servers usually use port 8082.

bouncie.title: Register a free Bouncie app
bouncie.description:
Bouncie asks each person to register their own app, once. It takes about two minutes.

1. Open the [Bouncie developer portal]({developer_portal_url}) and sign in with the Bouncie account that owns the vehicle.
2. Create an application, and add this redirect URI exactly as written: `{redirect_url}`
3. Copy the app's Client ID and Client Secret into the boxes below.

Next, Bouncie asks you to approve access.

devices.title: Choose buses
devices.description: Select the bus(es) to follow. Next you'll set up the stop and schedule. A profile can also switch to any other vehicle on this account later.

reauth_bouncie.title: Sign in to Bouncie again
reauth_bouncie.description: Bouncie needs you to approve access again. You will be sent to Bouncie to sign in.

error.invalid_url: That doesn't look like a web address. It should look like gps.example.com:8082.
error.cannot_connect: Nothing answered at this address. Check the address and port (Traccar servers usually use 8082), and that Home Assistant can reach the server.
error.not_traccar: Something answered at this address, but it isn't a Traccar server. Ask your bus company for the exact server address.
error.invalid_auth: The server rejected this username or password.
error.no_devices: You're signed in, but this login can't see any buses. Ask your bus company to share the bus with this login.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.
abort.no_devices: This Bouncie account has no vehicles yet. Add the vehicle in the Bouncie app, then try again.
abort.wrong_account: You signed in to a different Bouncie account than the one this entry uses.
abort.missing_configuration: Bouncie isn't configured: add Application credentials for Bus Monitor first.

data.scan_interval: Seconds between GPS checks (only while watching for the bus)
data.show_panel: Show Bus Monitor map in the sidebar

reset_trip.name: Reset trip
reset_trip.description: Clear today's alert state for a bus profile so it can alert again.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Profile id (slug of the profile name).

suggest_checkpoints.name: Suggest checkpoints
suggest_checkpoints.description: From recorded trips, suggest where the bus typically is N minutes before it reaches the stop.

describe_location.name: Describe location
describe_location.description: Say where a bus is: the street, the cross streets either side, heading and time to your stop. Optionally speak it on a media player.

media_player_entity.name: Speakers
media_player_entity.description: Media players to speak on (optional, needs a TTS entity).

application_credentials.description: Register an app in the [Bouncie developer portal]({developer_portal_url}), add the redirect URI `{redirect_url}`, then paste its Client ID and Client Secret here.

season_over.title: {profile} is paused for the summer
season_over.description: The school year set for {profile} has ended, so Bus Monitor stopped watching for the bus. Before school starts, open Settings → Devices & services → Bus Monitor, find {profile}, choose ⋮ → Reconfigure → Edit the profile, check the times and the stop, set when the new school year ends and save. Tick "relearn the route" if the route changed.

user.title: Add a bus profile
user.description: Name this trip, then drag the map pin from your home to your stop, or tick 'use bus position' to use where the bus is right now. Make one profile for the morning and another for the afternoon if the times differ.

data.name: Profile name
data.use_bus_position: Use the bus's current position instead
data.expected_arrival: Normal arrival time at the stop
data.offline_after_min: Alert if no GPS fix for N minutes (0 = off)

data_description.announce_as: What alerts and "where is the bus?" call this bus, e.g. "Daniel's bus". Leave empty to use the vehicle's name.
data_description.season_end: Last school day. The profile pauses after it (no polling, no alerts) until you edit it and set the next school year's end.
data_description.device: Any vehicle this account can see, including ones not picked when the integration was added (e.g. a new bus for the school year).

menu_options.profile: Edit the profile (name, bus, stop, schedule, school year)

profile.title: Edit the bus profile
profile.description: Change the name, bus, stop or schedule. Checkpoints, recorded trips and entity IDs are kept, and scripts keep working with profile: {profile_id}. After the summer pause, check the times and the stop and set when this school year ends.

data.name: Profile name
data.use_bus_position: Use the bus's current position instead
data.expected_arrival: Normal arrival time at the stop
data.offline_after_min: Alert if no GPS fix for N minutes (0 = off)
data.relearn: Forget recorded trips and relearn the route

data_description.announce_as: What alerts and "where is the bus?" call this bus, e.g. "Daniel's bus". Leave empty to use the vehicle's name.
data_description.season_end: Last school day. The profile pauses after it (no polling, no alerts) until you edit it and set the next school year's end.
data_description.relearn: Tick if the route changed. Auto-placed checkpoints and measured timings start over; your own checkpoints stay where they are.
data_description.device: Any vehicle this account can see, including ones not picked when the integration was added (e.g. a new bus for the school year).

add_checkpoint.title: Add an alert checkpoint
add_checkpoint.description: Minutes-away checkpoints announce "Bus 12 is about 10 minutes away"; tick Auto-place to let recorded trips move it to where the bus usually is that many minutes out (from 5 trips). Street checkpoints announce "Bus 12 is at Elm Street"; leave the label blank to use the nearest cross street. Untick Announce to trial a spot silently.

data.label: Name (blank = automatic)
data.use_bus_position: Use the bus's current position instead

error.location_required: Drag the map pin to the spot, or tick 'use bus position'.
error.name_exists: That name is already used by another bus profile.
error.street_lookup_failed: Couldn't look up the street name. Type a name, or try again in a minute.
error.season_end_past: That date has already passed. Pick the last day of this school year.

create_entry.default: Profile saved. To hear alerts, [add the announcement blueprint]({blueprint_url}) or use a [ready-made automation]({guide_url}). Add alert checkpoints from the profile's ⋮ menu → Reconfigure, or on the Bus Monitor map.
